description: This file defines the LogFragment class, which is an Android Fragment that contains a LogView to display log data. It manages the creation and configuration of the view hierarchy including a ScrollView and a custom LogView, handles view inflation, and updates scrolling behavior when log data changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that hosts a LogView within a ScrollView, providing a UI component for displaying log messages.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets layout parameters, styling, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the views, attaches a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the view hierarchy.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
